```transcript
A> BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
BEGIN

A> SELECT 1 / 0; -- division_by_zero
ERROR:  22012: division by zero
```

*The transaction is now aborted. Even a perfectly innocent statement is refused.*

```transcript
A> SELECT 1 AS innocent; -- in_failed_sql_transaction
ERROR:  25P02: current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
```

*This first transaction uses full ROLLBACK. The next transaction checks COMMIT after an error; savepoint recovery has its own Scenario.*

```transcript
A> ROLLBACK;
ROLLBACK

A> SELECT 1 AS innocent;
 innocent 
----------
        1 
(1 row)

A> BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
BEGIN

A> INSERT INTO samples VALUES (1);
INSERT 0 1

A> SELECT 1 / 0;
ERROR:  22012: division by zero

A> COMMIT; -- a failed transaction ends by rolling back, even when COMMIT is sent
ROLLBACK

A> SELECT count(*)::int AS remaining FROM samples;
 remaining 
-----------
         0 
(1 row)
```
